title: Rent vs. Own Cost Comparison

scenes.fact: The average annual rent premium over buying is $12,000 in many metros.
scenes.text: Renting can cost $12,000 more than owning annually.
Homeowners build equity of about $5,000 per year on average.

scenes.label: 5-Year Rule
scenes.text: Consider buying if you stay 5 years.
Follow for the money mindset they don't teach you.

description: Renting may look cheaper, but over five years buying can save you tens of thousands. Learn how to evaluate the true cost of rent versus ownership. Follow for more real estate money wisdom.
